# Jev vs LLM judge: benchmark brief

- App version recorded with the run: REPLAY benchmark/results (v1.0.3 frozen)
- Run completed: 2026-09-26T12:50:08Z
- Brief generated: 2026-09-27T13:14:48.106Z by current app vX-CHANGED-AFTER-RUN (export version; may differ from the recorded version above)
- Rows in the run: 47 (frozen when the run started; later dataset edits are not included)
- LLM judge: unknown
- Pass threshold for agreement: score ≥ 3

## Same-workload comparison

Scope: **partial**. A row is compared only when both judges scored exactly the same metrics and cost and time were recorded for both.

- Compared rows: **38 of 47**, covering 137 metric evaluations per judge
- Excluded rows: 9 (judges scored different metrics: 9)
- Estimated cost on the compared rows: Jev $0.00232, LLM judge $0.273
- Same-workload cost ratio (LLM judge ÷ Jev): **118×**
- Projected: Jev $0.061 vs LLM judge $7.191 per 1,000 rows (from the compared rows)
- Time per compared row (median): Jev 296 ms (one call scores all metrics of the row); LLM judge 7.99 s (sum of its per-metric call times; calls run in parallel, so actual wait per row is lower and was not measured)

Case membership (38 compared, 9 excluded) is listed per row in the app's "Show compared / excluded cases" view and can be re-derived from the full results export.

## Full run, measured

| | Jev | LLM judge |
|---|---|---|
| Calls | 47 of 47 rows (one per row, all metrics) | 155 (one per metric) |
| Metric scores returned | 164 (+24 not applicable) | 155 (+33 not applicable, no call) |
| Time per call, median / p95 | 296 ms / 385 ms (covers every metric of the row) | 1.95 s / 3.05 s (one metric) |
| Time per row, median | 296 ms (same single call) | 6.38 s (sum of per-metric calls over 47 rows) |
| Estimated cost, whole run | $0.00283 | $0.305 |
| Projected cost | $0.060 per 1,000 rows | $1.966 per 1,000 metric calls |

Whole-run totals use different units (Jev per row, LLM judge per metric call), so they are not divided into a ratio; the only ratio is the same-workload one above.

Pricing: not recorded for this run (older or replayed run). Unit prices are unknown; the app's current prices are not applied. Row costs above are the ones recorded with the results.

## Agreement with dataset labels

| Metric | Jev ↔ labels | LLM judge ↔ labels | Jev ↔ LLM judge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intent resolution | 91.5% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.41 (n = 47 score pairs) | 76.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.98 (n = 47 score pairs) | 76.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.88 (n = 47 score pairs) |
| Task adherence | 70.2% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.77 (n = 47 score pairs) | 59.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.7 (n = 47 score pairs) | 76.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.48 (n = 47 score pairs) |
| Tool call accuracy | 87.5% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.88 (n = 32 score pairs) | 82.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.78 (n = 23 score pairs) | 69.6% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.76 (n = 23 score pairs) |
| Groundedness | 97.4% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.64 (n = 38 score pairs) | 76.3% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.26 (n = 38 score pairs) | 73.7% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1 (n = 38 score pairs) |
| All metrics | 86.0% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.66 (n = 164 score pairs) | 72.3% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.24 (n = 155 score pairs) | 74.8% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.07 (n = 155 score pairs) |

n counts metric score pairs where both sides have a numeric score; unlabelled, not-applicable and failed scores are left out, not counted as 0.

## Limitations

- Labels are the ones in this dataset. For the bundled samples they are synthetic labels written by the dataset author, not an independent human study.
- One run on one dataset. No confidence interval is given; this is not a general performance claim for either judge.
- Costs are estimates from recorded tokens and list prices. Missing cost or time is reported as unknown and excluded from like-for-like figures.
- LLM judge per-row time is a sum of per-metric call times, not measured wall time. Jev time is one call per row.
- Cost and speed say nothing about accuracy; read agreement separately with its own n.

## Full evidence

This brief contains no trace text, prompts or keys. For row-level evidence use the app's Export step: Results (JSONL/CSV, every row and metric of this run), Benchmark summary (JSON) and Dataset (JSONL/CSV; note it holds the current dataset, which may include edits made after this run).
